name: openchatcut
description: Open-source ChatCut alternative: local-first, agent-native AI video editor with MCP.
author: OpenChatCut Contributors

scripts.predev: npm run sync:mediapipe && npm run sync:whisper-cli && npm run verify:server-tool-catalog
scripts.predev:isolated: npm run sync:mediapipe && npm run verify:server-tool-catalog
scripts.predev:shared: npm run sync:mediapipe && npm run verify:server-tool-catalog
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/sync-shader-sources.mjs --check && npm run sync:mediapipe && npm run sync:whisper-cli && npm run verify:server-tool-catalog
scripts.desktop:build:main: esbuild desktop/bootstrap.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --external:./app-main.mjs --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/main.mjs && esbuild desktop/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/app-main.mjs && esbuild desktop/native-asr-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/native-asr-worker.mjs && esbuild desktop/native-semantic-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/native-semantic-worker.mjs && esbuild desktop/native-clap-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/native-clap-worker.mjs && esbuild desktop/native-rhythm-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/native-rhythm-worker.mjs && esbuild desktop/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=desktop-dist/preload.cjs
scripts.desktop:dev:shared: vite build --config config/vite.config.ts && npm run desktop:build:main && electron desktop-dist/main.mjs
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run desktop:build:main && CC_SMOKE=1 electron desktop-dist/main.mjs
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:prebundle && tsx desktop/prepare-target.mts darwin-arm64 && CC_EB_TARGET=darwin-arm64 electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:local: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:prebundle && tsx desktop/prepare-target.mts darwin-arm64 && CC_EB_TARGET=darwin-arm64 electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac-x64: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:prebundle && tsx desktop/prepare-target.mts darwin-x64 && CC_EB_TARGET=darwin-x64 electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:prebundle && tsx desktop/prepare-target.mts win32-x64 && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js','--config','config/electron-builder.config.mjs','--win','nsis','--x64','--publish','never'],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,CC_EB_TARGET:'win32-x64'}});if(result.error)throw result.error;process.exit(result.status??1)"
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:prebundle && tsx desktop/prepare-target.mts linux-x64 && CC_EB_TARGET=linux-x64 electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.config.mjs --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
